class.name: CgameFramePacing
class.brief_description: Chooses V-Sync mode and frame rate cap per quality level.
class.description: [CgameFramePacing] favors steady frame delivery over a higher but jittery average. Quality levels map to V-Sync and [member Engine.max_fps] settings derived from the display refresh rate: [b]0 (Performance):[/b] V-Sync on; capped to half the refresh rate on panels above 90 Hz, otherwise to the refresh rate. [b]1 (Balanced):[/b] V-Sync on; capped to the refresh rate. [b]2 (High):[/b] adaptive V-Sync; capped to the refresh rate. [b]3 (Ultra):[/b] mailbox V-Sync (newest frame wins, no tearing, lowest latency) and no cap. Refresh rates below 30 Hz are treated as unknown and replaced by 60 Hz. Levels are clamped to [code]0..3[/code].

method.name: apply
method.description: Applies the settings for [param level] using the current display refresh rate: sets the V-Sync mode of the main window (skipped on the headless display server) and [member Engine.max_fps]. Returns the applied settings as in [method settings].

method.name: display_refresh
method.description: Returns the refresh rate of the main window's screen in Hz, or [code]60.0[/code] when it is unknown.

method.name: settings
method.description: Returns the settings for [param level] on a display refreshing at [param refresh_hz] as a dictionary with [code]vsync[/code] (a [enum DisplayServer.VSyncMode] value) and [code]max_fps[/code] (an integer, [code]0[/code] meaning unlimited).
